items.corrections: The prior positive evidence was a type 1 diabetes islet study and does not support the assigned aging claim. Targeted aging-reprogramming candidate could not be opened; broad human rejuvenation and cancer-safety claim remain unsupported.
No opened primary page established a root-cause cure for Alzheimer’s or other neurodegenerative disorders. Claimed downstream impacts are unsupported.
Search results describe ongoing HIV cure strategies, but no opened primary result substantiated a universal durable cure. Claimed downstream impacts are unsupported.
No opened clinical primary source established scarless regeneration of complex human organs in adults. Claimed downstream impacts are unsupported.

Read primary pharmacology abstract supports selective NaV1.8 inhibition and bounded acute-pain safety data; preserving all protective pain, complete chronic pathological-pain block and lifelong absence of dependence are not established.

Read PATHFINDER primary abstract demonstrates multicancer-screening feasibility and substantial diagnostic workups/false positives; virtually all curable-stage cancers, low cost and survival impact are unsubstantiated.

Read author-hosted NEJM report demonstrates customized liver-directed editing for one infant with initial seven-week follow-up; whole-body universal efficiency, no off-target effects and broad cures are not established.

The search found antigen-specific tolerance as a research direction, but no opened clinical source proved reversal of advanced autoimmune disease without broad immunosuppression. Claimed downstream impacts are unsupported.
No opened primary page established fully functional bioengineered organs grown on demand. Claimed downstream impacts are unsupported.
No opened primary source established a universal safe antigen-tolerance platform. Claimed downstream impacts are unsupported.
